issues.detail: R3 example expected q=16 after q=9, but BCD ones wrap should give q=0x10=16 only if tens increments; however R3 condition only checks ones==9 and does not increment tens, so example contradicts rule field (tens increment missing).

R4 example shows ena=1 at q=9 then q=16, but rule condition only ones==9; ena should be asserted when tens increments, i.e., at q=9 before edge, yet example expected ena=1 at q=9 row and 0 after, inconsistent with next_cycle visibility.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.

issues.detail: R5 example expected q=256 after q=99, but BCD increment of 99 should give 0x100=256 only if hundreds increments; rule condition lacks hundreds increment and ena=3 at q=99 is inconsistent with ena bit ordering.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.

issues.detail: R6 example expected q=4096 after q=999, but BCD increment of 999 should give 0x1000=4096 only if thousands increments; rule condition lacks thousands increment and ena=7 at q=999 is inconsistent with ena bit ordering.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.

issues.detail: R7 marked uncertain=true, violating requirement that absent verbatim evidence be flagged; spec does not state full wrap behavior.
ena bit ordering for digits [3:1] undefined; contract assumes ena[0]=tens, ena[1]=hundreds, ena[2]=thousands but alternative is reversed.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.

issues.detail: Spec does not state whether counting begins immediately after reset deassert or holds one cycle; contract assumes immediate increment.
issues.alternative: hold q=0 for one cycle after reset deassert before first increment

issues.detail: R2 example expected q=1 after reset release, but R1 example expected q=0 then q=1; R2 and R1 examples conflict on first post-reset value.
R8 condition 'not (q[3:0]==9)' does not cover cases where ones==9 but upper digits not all 9; ena default should be 0 for those, but R8 excludes them leaving gap.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.

issues.detail: Derived BCD counter from spec: reset->0000; then 0001,0002,...,0009,0010,0011,...; ena should indicate tens/hundreds/thousands increments. Contract examples show q=16 after q=9 (correct BCD) but R3 rule condition only ones==9, missing tens increment; R4-R6 examples show ena values inconsistent with BCD carry chain.
issues.spec_evidence: Each decimal digit is encoded using 4 bits: q[3:0] is the ones digit, q[7:4] is the tens digit, etc.
